Mega Beauty Festival Returns to Singapore Expo Hall 5B: Up to 90% Off 500+ Beauty Brands, Free Entry, 30 Oct-1 Nov and 6-9 Nov 2026 | MissLobang Miss Lobang Food Deals Lifestyle News Kids 中文 Deals Mega Beauty Festival Returns to Singapore Expo Hall 5B: Up to 90% Off 500+ Beauty Brands, Free Entry, 30 Oct-1 Nov and 6-9 Nov 2026
 Joe's Outlets is bringing its Mega Beauty Festival back to Singapore Expo, this time in Hall 5B and in partnership with TikTok Shop. Entry is free, it runs 10am to 9pm, and the organiser promises 500+ beauty products at up to 90% off. It is split into two blocks: Fri 30 Oct to Sun 1 Nov, then Fri 6 to Mon 9 Nov, so the hall is shut from 2 to 5 Nov. The official Starbuys posters already print real prices: La Mer's Moisturizing Soft Cream 60ml at $280 (RSP $670), Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair 100ml at $99 (RSP $185), Clé de Peau's Correcting Cream Veil at $49.90 (RSP $110), Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey 100ml at $54.90, and clearance tables of DMCK and Healoine at $7.90 an item and Hexkin at $9.90. New this edition: a TikTok Shop live showdown with live-only flash drops, and a $2,000 giveaway of ten $200 fair vouchers.
 Priya Nair 28 October 2026 5 min read Singapore's big free-entry beauty fair is back for a second round this year. Joe's Outlets' Mega Beauty Festival opens at Singapore Expo Hall 5B this Friday, with 500+ beauty products at up to 90% off , 10am to 9pm , and no admission fee . This edition is run with TikTok Shop , which adds live-stream flash drops on top of the floor prices. 
 > Quick view: up to 90% off, 500+ beauty products · Singapore Expo Hall 5B · FREE entry · 10am-9pm · Fri 30 Oct-Sun 1 Nov and Fri 6-Mon 9 Nov 2026 · closed 2-5 Nov · Starbuys from $7.90 . 
 The dates: two blocks, not ten days 
 Block 1: Fri 30 Oct, Sat 31 Oct, Sun 1 Nov 
 Closed: Mon 2 to Thu 5 Nov 
 Block 2: Fri 6, Sat 7, Sun 8 and Mon 9 Nov (Mon 9 Nov is the Deepavali holiday Monday) 
 Every open day runs 10am to 9pm . The venue is Singapore Expo, Hall 5B (1 Expo Drive) , a short covered walk from Expo MRT on the East West and Downtown lines. Note the hall: the August edition was in Hall 6A. 
 Starbuys: the prices already printed 
 The organiser has released category posters with fixed prices against retail, which is more than most warehouse sales give you. Highlights from the official posters: 
 Product Fair price RSP 
 La Mer Moisturizing Soft Cream 60ml $280 $670 
 Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair 100ml $99 $185 
 Clé de Peau Correcting Cream Veil 37ml $49.90 $110 
 SK-II Facial Treatment Clear Lotion 230ml $78 $139 
 SK-II Essential Travel Kit $48 $99 
 Shiseido Global Suncare The Perfect Protector 50ml $37.90 $70 
 La Prairie Foam Cleanser 125ml $90 $175 
 Burberry Brit Sheer EDT 100ml $45.90 72% off 
 Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey 100ml $54.90 n/a 
 Round Lab Birch Juice Sun Spray $12.90 $30 
 The real 90% off lives on the clearance tables : every Hexkin item is $9.90 , and DMCK and Healoine are $7.90 an item . Other brands on the posters include Mugler, Bvlgari, Giorgio Armani, Montblanc, YSL, Anna Sui, Hermès, Coach, Gucci, Jo Malone, Maison Margiela, Chanel, Givenchy, NARS, Laneige, TirTir, Jung Saem Mool, Ma:nyo, Medicube, Sulwhasoo, Lancôme, Beauty of Joseon, Abib and SKIN1004. 
 What is new this time 
 TikTok Shop live showdown. Local creators go live from the fair with live-only flash drops and stackable vouchers . You can swatch a product on the floor, then check out through the live stream if that price is lower. 
 $2,000 giveaway. Ten winners each get $200 in fair vouchers . Entry details are on the organiser's Instagram and TikTok. 
 The car draw is unconfirmed. The official site still shows the spend-over-S$300 grand draw (a Dongfeng BOX car, iPhone 17 Pros, Dyson prizes), but its printed draw date is from an earlier edition and the October posters do not mention it. Ask at the fair before shopping toward S$300. 
 The fine print 
 "Up to 90%" is a ceiling on selected lines, not the discount across the floor. 
 Starbuys are while stocks last. The La Mer and Estée Lauder lines are the ones most likely to sell out on day one. 
 Check expiry and batch dates on clearance skincare and sunscreen. Short-dated stock is how a table reaches $7.90. 
 Ask about exchanges before paying. Fair booths usually sell as-is. 
 How to shop it 
 Go Friday 30 Oct at 10am if you are after a specific Starbuy. Go in the second block if you would rather have deeper cuts on what is left. 
 Price-check anything over $50 against Sephora, Shopee or Lazada on your phone. Prestige skincare and fragrance are usually genuine wins; current K-beauty hits often are not. 
 Keep the TikTok Shop live open while you shop. The live-only drops can undercut the floor price on the same item. 
 The official fragrance Starbuys poster. (Image: Mega Beauty Festival by Joe's Outlets) Frequently Asked Questions
 When and where is the Mega Beauty Festival in October-November 2026? + At Singapore Expo Hall 5B (1 Expo Drive, next to Expo MRT on the East West and Downtown lines), in two blocks: Friday 30 October to Sunday 1 November, and Friday 6 to Monday 9 November 2026. Both blocks open 10am to 9pm. The hall is closed from Monday 2 to Thursday 5 November, so do not make the trip mid-week. Entry is free and no ticket is needed.
 Which deals are actually worth it at the Mega Beauty Festival? + The official Starbuys posters are the best guide, because they print prices against retail. The biggest cuts in cash terms are prestige skincare: La Mer's Moisturizing Soft Cream 60ml at $280 against an RSP of $670, Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair 100ml at $99 against $185, and Clé de Peau's Correcting Cream Veil at $49.90 against $110. Fragrance is the other strong aisle, with Burberry Brit Sheer 100ml at $45.90 (72% off) and Coach and Anna Sui sets from $29.90. The true 90% sits on the clearance tables, where everything from Hexkin is $9.90 and DMCK and Healoine are $7.90 an item. Check expiry dates on clearance skincare before paying.
 Is there a lucky draw at this Mega Beauty Festival? + There is a confirmed $2,000 giveaway: ten winners each get $200 in Mega Beauty Festival shopping vouchers, with entry details on the organiser's Instagram and TikTok. The official site also still shows the spend-over-S$300 grand draw for a Dongfeng BOX car, iPhone 17 Pros and Dyson prizes, but its printed draw date (8/3/2026) belongs to an earlier edition and the October posters do not mention it. Ask at the fair before you spend toward the S$300 line.

DATES: Fri 30 Oct-Sun 1 Nov and Fri 6-Mon 9 Nov 2026 , 10am-9pm ; closed 2-5 Nov. STARBUYS: La Mer Moisturizing Soft Cream 60ml $280 (RSP $670), Estée Lauder Advanced Night Repair 100ml $99 (RSP $185), Clé de Peau Correcting Cream Veil $49.90 (RSP $110), SK-II Facial Treatment Clear Lotion 230ml $78 (RSP $139), Burberry Brit Sheer 100ml $45.90 , Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey 100ml $54.90 ; clearance tables of DMCK and Healoine at $7.90 an item and Hexkin at $9.90 . EXTRAS: TikTok Shop live showdown with live-only flash drops and stackable vouchers; $2,000 giveaway of ten $200 fair vouchers (entry details on the organiser's Instagram and TikTok). FINE PRINT: up to 90% is on selected items; Starbuys prices are from the official posters and are while stocks last; the official site's car grand-draw board still shows an earlier edition's draw date, so confirm any draw at the fair.
